description: Search the national data catalogue I14Y by words (Datensatz, Schnittstelle, API, Behördenleistung, Codeliste): use first, to find who publishes what. hint.

lang.description: The language searched AND served (de|fr|it|en|rm); default de.

publishers.description:
Publisher CODES — the `identifier` `i14y.list_publishers`
serves («CH1» is the Federal Statistical Office) — never a name.

query.description:
Free text, e.g. «Sonderpädagogik», «Zoll», «API»; empty lists
the whole index one page at a time. Matched in `lang`.

themes.description:
Theme CODES as a hit carries them under `themes[].code`
(«103» is Bildung) — never a word.

types.description:
Restrict to resource types: Dataset | DataService |
PublicService | Concept | MappingTable. Each of them answers.

name: i14y.search_catalog
